description: Complete a login started with login_mal by submitting the URL your browser was redirected to after clicking Allow (the one containing ?code=...). Use this when login didn't complete automatically — e.g. the server runs on a remote/headless host. A bare code string is also accepted.

redirect_url.description: The full redirected URL (contains ?code=...), or just the code value.

name: submit_mal_redirect
title: Finish MyAnimeList login
